card.name: Digits inside long numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit in the middle of a long multi-digit number, often after comma-separated groups, in counts, statistics, or ID numbers. It is not the first digit or the final one.

modes.label: Comma-grouped large counts
modes.description: A digit inside a big number written with thousands separators, such as record counts or production totals.

modes.label: Digits in decimals or IDs
modes.description: A digit within a long decimal or a reference number.

card.plain: It fires on a digit in the middle of a long number, such as a big count with commas.
